daily_session_clock.note: D1 high/low/open must follow the MT5 broker day. BRT is used only for the operational trading window.

methodology.daily_direction: BULLISH if price > broker_daily_open; BEARISH if price < broker_daily_open; NEUTRAL otherwise
methodology.higher_timeframe_availability: Use only completed H1/M15 bars at each M5 decision timestamp in the research script.

research_evidence.reason: The first exploratory pass supported asymmetric D1-position effects, but the definitive run must use broker-day D1 boundaries. Therefore all runtime effects remain soft/warning-only until the broker-day OOS study passes.

bullish_zone.observed_edge: BUY continuation favored in the exploratory sample

bearish_zone.observed_edge: SELL continuation favored, weaker than the bullish side

extreme_high.observed_edge: Continuation edge degraded versus the 0.70-0.90 zone
extreme_high.interpretation: Potential exhaustion / buy-side liquidity sweep; do not chase BUY solely because price is at the high.

extreme_low.observed_edge: SELL continuation degraded and reversal behavior increased
extreme_low.interpretation: Potential exhaustion / sell-side liquidity sweep; do not chase SELL solely because price is at the low.

neutral_zone.interpretation: D1 position should not select direction; defer to H1/M15/M5.

research_evidence.promotion_rule: Promote WARNING_ONLY to HARD_FILTER only if the broker-day 60/20/20 OOS study improves test expectancy and profit factor, does not materially reduce sample size, and the direction is stable across train/validation/test.
